title: 1 Samuel 29
paragraphs: ¹ The Philistines assembled all their forces at Aphek, while the Israelites camped by the spring at Jezreel. ² The Philistine commanders marched past in their units of hundreds and thousands, and David and his men brought up the rear with Achish. ³ The Philistine commanders asked, "What are these Hebrews doing here?" Achish replied, "This is David, who used to serve Saul king of Israel. He's been with me for over a year, and I've found nothing wrong with him from the day he came over to me until now." ⁴ But the Philistine commanders were angry with Achish. "Send the man back," they said. "Let him return to the place you assigned him. He can't go into battle with us — he might turn against us in the fight. What better way to win back his master's favor than by taking the heads of our own men? ⁵ Isn't this the David they sing about in their dances: 'Saul has struck down his thousands, and David his tens of thousands'?"

⁶ Achish called David and said, "As surely as the LORD lives, you have been loyal and I've valued your service alongside me in the army. I've found nothing wrong with you from the day you arrived until today. But the other commanders don't trust you. ⁷ Go back in peace, and don't do anything to upset the Philistine commanders." ⁸ David said to Achish, "But what have I done? What have you found against me from the day I entered your service until today? Why can't I go fight against the enemies of my lord the king?" ⁹ Achish answered, "I know you're as reliable as an angel of God, as far as I'm concerned. But the Philistine commanders have decided you cannot march out with them. ¹⁰ Get up early in the morning, you and the men who came with you, and leave at first light."
¹¹ So David and his men rose early and headed back to Philistine territory, while the Philistines marched on to Jezreel.
